units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:3:14">Y. Peah VII, 20ᵇ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="C01388"><he>גָּרַף</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 4:1:4">Y. Sabb. IV, beg. 6ᵈ</cite> <he>אם רָבַת רַקְבּוּבִיתָן</he> if the decay in them (from moths) is far advanced.
<cite ref="Yoma 38b:4">Yoma 38ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 10:7">Prov. X, 7</cite>); <he>רַקְבִּיבוּת תעלה בשמותן וכ׳</he> rottenness enters their names, none name their children after them.
